operations.name: StartRun
operations.document: mutation StartRun($input: StartRunInput!) { dispatch { startRun(input: $input) { output { runId manifestId manifestExternalId trainName armedCrash maxRetries } } } }

operations.name: ChangeCaseData
operations.document: mutation ChangeCaseData($runId: String!) { dispatch { changeCaseData(input: { runId: $runId }) { output { change } } } }

operations.name: Executions
operations.document: query Executions($manifestId: Long!) { operations { executions(manifestId: $manifestId, order: OLDEST, take: 20) { items { id trainState startTime endTime failureJunction failureReason } } } }

operations.name: Execution
operations.document: query Execution($id: Long!) { operations { execution(id: $id) { id trainState startTime endTime failureJunction failureReason } } }

operations.name: OnJunctionEvent
operations.document: subscription OnJunctionEvent($metadataId: Long!) { onJunctionEvent(metadataId: $metadataId) { eventType sequence junction { position kind name state startedAt endedAt durationMs failureClass failureException questionKey answer confidence replayed answerWithheld nameWithheld trackPosition attempt nodeId } } }

operations.name: JunctionRuns
operations.document: query JunctionRuns($metadataId: Long!) { operations { junctionRuns(metadataId: $metadataId) { position kind name state startedAt endedAt durationMs failureClass failureException questionKey answer confidence replayed answerWithheld nameWithheld trackPosition attempt nodeId } } }

operations.name: DecisionJournal
operations.document: query DecisionJournal($metadataId: Long!) { discover { decisionJournal(input: { metadataId: $metadataId }) { replayDecisionsOf replayAbandoned decisions { questionKey occurrence replayed replayRefused model stateHash } } } }

operations.name: TriggerAskAfresh
operations.document: mutation TriggerAskAfresh($externalId: String!) { operations { triggerManifest(externalId: $externalId, askAfresh: true) { success message } } }

operations.name: Requeue
operations.document: mutation Requeue($id: Long!, $askAfresh: Boolean!) { operations { requeueExecution(id: $id, askAfresh: $askAfresh) { success message id } } }

operations.name: Resume
operations.document: mutation Resume($id: Long!, $from: String) { operations { resumeExecution(id: $id, from: $from) { success message id } } }

operations.name: WorkQueueEntry
operations.document: query WorkQueueEntry($id: Long!) { operations { workQueue { workQueue(id: $id) { id status metadataId } } } }

operations.name: RunGraph
operations.document: query RunGraph($metadataId: Long!) { operations { runGraph(metadataId: $metadataId) { hasGraph allNodes { id kind junction state replayed trackTaken canResume checkpointed parentId track tracks { name taken } } } } }
